title: Part 6 Email 填空
summary: 面試通知和訂單問題：讀懂 email 的來龍去脈。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: Part 6 最常出現 email。先看 Subject（主旨）就知道這封信在講什麼。
文法題看空格前後幾個字就能解；句子題一定要看前後句，選意思接得上的。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 題型
選項長相
怎麼解
rows: 修飾整句或形容詞，用副詞
看上下句，選意思接得上的

steps.tip: Thank you for ＋ 名詞或 V-ing；be sorry for ＋ 名詞：這兩個很常考。

items.en: Thank you for applying for the position.
We look forward to meeting you.
The chairs are currently out of stock.
We are sorry for the inconvenience.

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示整篇文章，看到第幾個空格就作答那一格。

questions.prompt: 第 1 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: Thank you for 後面接名詞或 V-ing，for applying：謝謝你應徵。
questions.text:
To: Mark Evans
From: Lucy Park
Subject: Job Interview

Dear Mr. Evans,

Thank you for (1)______ for the sales assistant position. We would like to invite you to an interview on Tuesday, May 14, at 10 a.m. The interview will take about 30 minutes. (2)______, please bring a copy of your résumé. If this time is not (3)______ for you, please call me at 555-0147. (4)______

Best regards,
Lucy Park
HR Manager

questions.prompt: 第 2 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 前面說面試時間，這裡「另外」請帶履歷，用 Also。
questions.text:

questions.prompt: 第 3 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: is not 後面放形容詞：convenient（方便的）。

questions.prompt: 第 4 個空格要填什麼？
options: We look forward to meeting you.
The position has already been filled.
questions.answer: We look forward to meeting you.
questions.explanation: 邀請面試的信，結尾說「期待見面」最自然。職位已經找到人的話就不會邀請面試。

questions.prompt: 第 5 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 修飾 out of stock（缺貨），用副詞 currently（目前）。
questions.text:
Dear Ms. Wong,

We have received your order for 20 office chairs. Unfortunately, the chairs you ordered are (5)______ out of stock. We expect to receive more next week. (6)______ We can also offer you a similar model in black at the same price. Please let us know which option you (7)______. We are sorry (8)______ the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Tom Hill
Customer Service

questions.prompt: 第 6 個空格要填什麼？
options: We will ship your order as soon as they arrive.
We do not sell office furniture.
questions.answer: We will ship your order as soon as they arrive.
questions.explanation: 前一句說下週會進貨，接「一到貨就出貨」最合理。

questions.explanation: which option you ___：主詞 you 後面要接動詞 prefer。

questions.prompt: 第 8 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: be sorry for ＋ 名詞：為…感到抱歉。
questions.text:
Dear Ms. Wong,

We have received your order for 20 office chairs. Unfortunately, the chairs you ordered are (5)______ out of stock. We expect to receive more next week. questions.prompt: out of stock 是什麼意思？
questions.explanation: out of stock：沒有庫存、缺貨。in stock 是有貨。
sorry for the inconvenience：造成不便很抱歉。
